title: IRA Desk Reference: Withdrawals That Reduce the Surrender Free Amount on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
On full surrender of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract, the surrender free amount is reduced by withdrawals taken since the latest contract anniversary. Which of those withdrawals reduce it depends on the tax registration and on the kinds of withdrawal taken.

**Rule.** The withdrawals that reduce the surrender free amount are:

- on a traditional IRA or SEP IRA contract with required minimum distribution withdrawals since the latest contract anniversary — every withdrawal since that anniversary **except** those required minimum distribution withdrawals;
- on any other contract with withdrawals since that anniversary under an approved surrender charge waiver — every withdrawal since that anniversary **except** the waiver withdrawals;
- otherwise — every withdrawal since that anniversary.

The tax registration is read from the contract record; the activity history shows each withdrawal's class, including required minimum distribution withdrawals and waiver withdrawals (partial withdrawals taken under an approved nursing home or terminal illness waiver).

**Decision table (withdrawals since the latest contract anniversary).**

| Tax registration | Any required minimum distribution withdrawals | Any waiver withdrawals | Withdrawals that reduce the surrender free amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Traditional IRA or SEP IRA | Yes | Yes or no | All except the required minimum distribution withdrawals |
| Traditional IRA or SEP IRA | No | Yes | All except the waiver withdrawals |
| Traditional IRA or SEP IRA | No | No | All |
| Roth IRA or non-qualified | Yes or no | Yes | All except the waiver withdrawals |
| Roth IRA or non-qualified | Yes or no | No | All |

**Worked cases (hypothetical).**

- Traditional IRA: required minimum distribution $2500, partial withdrawal $1000 → $1000 reduces the free amount.
- Traditional IRA: required minimum distribution $2500, waiver withdrawal $4000, partial withdrawal $1000 → $5000 reduces it (only the required minimum distribution is left out).
- Non-qualified: waiver withdrawal $4000, partial withdrawal $1000 → $1000 reduces it.
- Roth IRA: required minimum distribution $2500 only → $2500 reduces it.
